    Generator formulas for direct-sum Fubini equivalences #

    Small reusable lemmas for the three direct-sum operations used in orbit Fubini arguments: mapping each fiber, uncurrying a dependent pair of indices, and reindexing along an equivalence.

    noncomputable def MagnitudeConjecture.DirectSumFubini.mapRangeLinearEquiv {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {iota : Type uI} {beta : iota → Type uM} {gamma : iota → Type uT} [(i : iota) → AddCommMonoid (beta i)] [(i : iota) → Module R (beta i)] [(i : iota) → AddCommMonoid (gamma i)] [(i : iota) → Module R (gamma i)] (e : (i : iota) → beta i ≃ₗ[R] gamma i) :
    DirectSum iota beta ≃ₗ[R] DirectSum iota gamma
